propositions: Author-facing repair surfaces (CLI verb, library, MCP tool) for retroactive commit linking via botched rebar-ticket trailers are missing and must be shipped with all-or-nothing SHA validation in the seam.
Deterministic close-gate check must block if any linked commit's paths are not covered by file_impact declaration or owned exemption globs (tests/**, docs/**, **/*.md, CHANGELOG.md).
Path matching must reuse the repo's **/‐aware glob semantics (hoisted to shared DET module commit_impact.py, delegated from existing copies in prompts.py and registry.py) without importing rebar.llm.

Merge commits must be explicitly skipped in the close check because git show emits combined diffs (empty path lists) that would silently pass; commits reachable from HEAD via rebar-ticket trailers are discovered and union-compared against the file_impact set of the ticket and all transitive descendants.
Source-(ii) local commits failing git show must fail closed (block with SHA named), while source-(i) recorded SHAs absent locally must be skipped to avoid false-positives on unfetched commits.

The close-precheck refactor must preserve the existing _referencing_commit_exists bool contract and API surface (documented monkeypatch target) while extracting SHA-returning _referencing_commits internally.
